verdict.rationale: The core product is a Mac desktop app that runs agents in local git worktrees on your own machine through your local Claude Code installation, so the core workflow executes on user hardware (conductor-probe-1, conductor-comm-15, conductor-comm-17). It is described as closed-source, unlike open-source alternatives (conductor-comm-8), and the cloud workspaces, sandboxes and MCP server are vendor-hosted with no documented self-hosted deployment (conductor-docs-20, conductor-docs-14). Missing for 10: a documented self-hosted deployment of the cloud/backend components, an open-source or source-available release, offline operation without vendor sign-in, and independent confirmation of self-hosting.
